verdict.rationale: Defining agent (mandatário) authority is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. The pack never publishes the authorization or power-of-attorney forms, what an agent may or may not do, or which acts and signatures must stay personal to the holder. The only nearby items are adjacent: a free service to update agent contact data, and licence recordal, which concerns exploitation rights rather than delegated filing authority. Neither counts toward this story.
